definitions.explanation: A tiny soft-bodied insect that clusters on plant stems and leaves and sucks their sap, a common garden and crop pest. It secretes a sweet substance that attracts ants.

examples.japanese: バラ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧アブラムシ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are lots of aphids on the roses.

examples.japanese: アブラムシ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汁|しる}→汁：10462_shiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}って→吸う：04394_suu⟧⟦{弱|よわ}らせる→弱る：02439_yowaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆除|くじょ}した→駆除する：21319_kujosuru⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よい。
examples.english: Aphids weaken plants by sucking their sap, so it is best to get rid of them early.

notes:
Usually written in katakana. A widespread pest on garden plants and crops; it sucks sap and can spread plant diseases.

- アブラムシ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: aphids infest (a plant)
- アブラムシ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駆除|くじょ}する→駆除する：21319_kujosuru⟧: to exterminate aphids
